articleTitle: A Digital Twin Approach for Modeling Electrical Characteristics of Bifacial Solar Panels
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Dynamic analysis of a bifacial solar panel’s electrical characteristics is essential for controlling and managing the PV system. However, most performance models of bifacial solar panels cannot adapt to changing environments in real-time. This paper proposes a digital twin approach for modelling the electrical characteristics of bifacial solar panels with a dynamic parameter estimation process. The proposed model is based on a double-diode bifacial circuit model. A continuously running four-state Jaya algorithm uses a sliding window dataset of the most recent sensor data to estimate equivalent circuit parameters. With environmental data and optimal parameters, the digital twin model can predict the electrical characteristics of the solar panel. A web-based interface is developed to display relevant digital twin information. Experimental results suggest that the digital twin model can accurately predict the electrical characteristics of an actual bifacial solar panel.

articleTitle: GAMC: An Oversampling Method Based on Genetic Algorithm and Monte Carlo Method to Solve the Class Imbalance Issue in Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of long-term steady in industrial production processes, there is a large amount of imbalanced data in it, which can make it difficult for detection models to accurately capture abnormal events and cause property damage. In this paper, a data oversampling method is proposed to balance the industrial process data from the perspective of sample distribution. This oversampling method uses the crossover and mutation processes of genetic algorithm to generate offspring samples, and then uses the monte carlo acceptance-rejection sampling method to determine whether the new attribute values match the distribution of original sample attribute values. This method can effectively enrich the information carried in the minority class samples and improve the effectiveness of classification model. In the experimental section, the results of the comparison with existing two classical oversampling methods on six publicly available datasets show that the algorithm in this paper outperforms the existing oversampling methods in terms of overall performance.

articleTitle: Design of Rural Road Lighting System Based on Internet of Things and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the promotion of China’s new rural construction and beautiful countryside movements, there is a growing demand to improve the living environment of residents in rural areas and meet the requirements for energy efficiency and sustainability by implementing novel technologies. The internet of things (IOT) that allows real-time monitoring, measurement, and control while ensuring sustainability has become the trend in the field of lighting management. On the other hand, deep learning algorithms could help to eliminate the labor-intensive and time-consuming mining and feature extraction of high-dimensional complex data, and provide analysis and optimization of control strategies in a much shorter time. In this study, we put forward a new lighting design model by integrating IOT and deep learning, and theoretically analyzed its feasibility and discussed its advantages, with the goal to provide a new scheme for the design of rural road lighting system that is energy-efficient with improved reliability, robust functionality and satisfying performance.

articleTitle: Risk Management of Aerospace Stand-Alone Device Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Aerospace stand-alone device is one of the core components of the spacecraft development system, and it’s supply chain management plays an extremely important role in the development system of the whole spacecraft engineering model. Risk in the whole supply chain, especially quality and reliability risk management directly determine the success of the task. With the deepening of specialized division of labor, the supply chain management of aerospace stand-alone device is developing from inside the wall to the whole chain outside the wall. The risks of the upstream and downstream partners of the supply chain will eventually be transmitted to the general unit. This paper is oriented to supply chain risk management, based on manufacturing supply chain theory [1], a method of “prevention first, risk moving forward and differentiated management” is proposed. It also explored and practiced specific working methods in typical links such as supplier sourcing access, on-site audit, new category identification and verification in the whole life cycle construction of aerospace stand-alone device supply chain [2].

articleTitle: Discussion on Smart Contract Under Blockchains Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: At present, blockchains has become a major trend at home and abroad. From the government’s announcement to the establishment of the blockchain infrastructure in Xiongan New Area, the development trend of blockchain cannot be ignored. With the development of blockchain,a new blockchain platform of Ethereum has emerged.This paper makes a further introduction to the core of Ethereum platform - Smart contract. Smart contract is a famous concept proposed by Nick Szabo in 1996. The emergence of blockchain and Ethereum makes it possible to use on a large scale. This paper also discusses the development of smart contract and its existing problems.

articleTitle: The Research of Low-Code Process Technology Applying on IT Operation and Maintenance System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to improve the development efficiency of workflow and reduce the operation cost in IT operation and maintenance system, the Domain Process Suite (DPS) suitable for this system was explored and researched by combining workflow technology and low-code technology, and it also be applied. Comparing the actual results, this application of low-code process technology in IT operation and maintenance system can greatly improve the development efficiency of system flow.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Predicting Customer Churn in A Credit Card Company
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: As marketplaces have become increasingly crowded, businesses have recognized the importance of focusing their business strategy on identifying customers who are likely to leave their services. To solve this, a technique for identifying these consumers must launch pre-emptive retention efforts to keep them. Therefore, to minimize costs and maximize efficiency, churn prediction must be as precise as possible to guarantee retention efforts are directed solely at customers who intend to transfer service providers. The study conducted in this report aims to establish a mechanism for anticipating churn in advance while minimizing misclassification. The suggested methodology integrates a temporal dimension into customer churn prediction to maximize future attrition capture by identifying probable customer loss as soon as possible. Six machine learning algorithms are selected and conducted to validate the suggested methodology using a bank credit card dataset. Finally, the proposed methodology’s results are compared to those published churn prediction methodologies. According to the research, clients can be classified into clusters based on their contracts with the service provider. It is conceivable to estimate when the customer might be expected to end their service with the organization.

articleTitle: Risk Warning and Prevention of Supply Chain in Automobile Industry Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: When manufacturing automobiles, a lot of automobile spare parts are needed, which gradually leads to the production of automobile spare parts, which is not manufactured by vehicle manufacturers, but completed by purchasing automobile spare parts, thus forming a supply chain. Therefore, it is particularly important to control the risk of automobile manufacturing supply chain, which is related to the success or failure of the whole supply chain. Based on the DM(data mining) technology, this paper studies the supply chain risk of automobile industry, and gives an early warning and prevention to the risk. Through the research and analysis, it can be found that whether the interval estimation of total assets turnover rate is compared with the industry value or the interval estimation of current assets turnover rate is compared with the industry value, all turnover indexes of automobile parts suppliers are higher than the industry average level, but there is a big gap from the industry excellent level. Spare parts suppliers will have a direct impact on automobile manufacturers, and if the situation is serious, it will also have an impact on the whole supply chain. Therefore, it is necessary for enterprises to identify the risks of suppliers, because risk identification can reduce the losses of enterprises to a certain extent and maximize the profits of enterprises.

articleTitle: Study on Panning, Modeling and Simulating for Digital Manufacturing System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This paper study on the objective-oriented modeling and simulating method for digital manufacturing system(DMS) according to the the analysis of planning, modeling and simulating. Analyzing and evaluating the production system capacity by use of simulating technology, can complete planning design, optimize parameters and configuration of production system, then validate process planning and improve production efficiency in early phase. Through the example about the automatic material transport system of parts digital manufacturing system based on the simulation software Arena, we highlight the importance of planning, modeling and simulating of DMS.

articleTitle: Research on Location Information and Privacy Protection Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the context of big data era, in order to prevent malicious access and information leakage during data services, researchers put forward a location big data encryption method based on privacy protection in practical exploration. According to the problems arising from the development of information network in recent years, users often encounter the situation of randomly obtaining location information in the network environment, which not only threatens their privacy security, but also affects the effective transmission of information. Therefore, this study proposed the privacy protection as the core position of big data encryption method, must first clear position with large data representation and positioning information, distinguish between processing position information and the unknown information, the fuzzy encryption theory, dynamic location data regrouping, eventually build privacy protection as the core of the encryption algorithm. The empirical results show that this method can not only effectively block the intrusion of attack data, but also effectively control the error of position data encryption.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting Network Security and Countermeasures Based on Network Attack Roadmap
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the information age, network technology has been applied to people’s travel, consumption activities, social activities and other fields. Network technology and information technology have become an inseparable part of people’s daily life and business activities. At the same time, network viruses and network attacks are becoming more and more frequent, and the number of viruses and computers infected with viruses is in the hundreds of millions. The forms and methods of network attacks are constantly being renovated, and the methods of attacks are becoming more secretive. Starting from the roadmap of network attack, this paper analyzes the steps of network attack and the factors that affect network security. Different coping strategies are proposed for different nodes in the attack to achieve the purpose of reducing the occurrence of network security incidents.

articleTitle: On the Optimization of New Energy Automobile Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to optimize the power control system of new energy vehicles,based on the design parameters of new energy vehicles, the simulation analysis model is established.In view of the design of switched reluctance drive motor and the selection of regenerative battery, this paper puts forward the problem, and studies the characteristics of battery capacity in influencing new energy vehicles.And according to the actual state of the new energy vehicle cycle control system operation, the new energy vehicle battery parameters optimization scheme is proposed to improve the efficiency of the battery, and by introducing the quality ratio coefficient of the battery’s charged state, the design of charging monomer specification capacity and combined capacity is comprehensively optimized.Aiming at simultaneously improving the power and economic performance of new energy vehicles, optimize the setting of vehicle driveline ratio from the overall aspect, and then carry out simulation analysis on this scheme.This is of great significance for improving the dynamic performance of new energy vehicles and increasing the operating mileage of new energy vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Modeling of Container Terminal Logistics System Based on WITNESS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s container terminals, how to make full use of the resources of container terminals through vaious management and technical means to increase the revenue of container terminals has become a subject that needs to be studied in the scale expansion and production management of container terminals. The location of distribution center plays an important strategic role in the planning and design of distribution center. To some extent, the location of distribution center affects the success or failure of distribution center operation. Container terminal is a complex dynamic system of discrete events, which has the characteristics of dynamics, randomness and asynchrony. According to the characteristics of terminal operation, the discrete event simulation theory is adopted, the simulation model is established based on the logistics operation process of container terminal, and the event-oriented simulation method is adopted to simulate the road traffic system of Tianjin Port container terminal based on simulation software. On the basis of the formal description of discrete event system (DEVS), the DEVS model of the container terminal handling system is constructed, and its simulation model is established in the eM Plant software. Taking a port as the application background, the correctness and effectiveness of the simulation model are verified.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Best Master Clock Selection Algorithm Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the rapid innovation of aerospace technology, aerospace-oriented TSN (Time Sensitive Network, TSN) network technology has been rapidly developed, among which the Best Master Clock Selection Algorithm (BMCA) is the guarantee of the TSN network clock Foundation. In this paper, on the basis of the analysis of the time synchronization protocol, the BMCA in the protocol is an analyzed, designed and implemented, and a system for implementing the BMCA with full hardware logic is proposed. This design uses two ZYNQ7020 boards as master-slave nodes. Through behavior simulation and timing simulation verification, the selection of the best master clock between the master-slave nodes is realized.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Closed Tank Capacity Measurement Method for Liquid Volume Supporting the Internet of Things, Big Data and Intelligent Ship Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The close bulkcapacity intelligent measurement is the important technical support for our country’s shipping internationalization, standardization, the close monitoring. In order to achieve the reliability, efficiency and accuracy of measurement results, it is necessary to actively integrate with industrial Internet of Things, big data and supply chain technology and other advanced technologies. Among them, the liquid tank volume measurement technology is the basis to support the ship intelligence, and also the basis for the ship bulk liquid trade handover, pollutant management, fuel consumption measurement and other requirements. Traditional manual measurement capacity metering timeconsuming, low precision, unable to obtain continuous realtime data, cannot satisfy large data analysis, and the analysis of the complex supply chain requirements, discrete, non realtime measurement data, unable to support the supervision department of the shipowners and shipping ship liquid fine management needs, unable to support multinational trade in bulk liquid delivery requirements of the ship. In this paper, a real-time closed-form liquid volume measurement method with multi-sensors including the Internet of Things architecture is proposed, and a large number basis for liquid volume of tank capacity is constructed, which includes relevant influencing factors such as ship floating state, tank temperature and tank shape. This method can provide real-time and accurate data in reliability, efficiency and accuracy, and provide technical support for intelligent supply chain management. Effectively improve the measurement accuracy of liquid tank, and realize remote data monitoring. This study has the value of theoretical research and practical application in the measurement of ship cabin liquid volume, and is of great significance in promoting the measurement of ship liquid cabin volume in the aspects of Internet of things, big data, intelligent supply chain and so on.

articleTitle: Identification Algorithm of Influencing Factors of Commercial Vehicles Based on Partial Least Squares Structural Equation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the strategy of expanding domestic demand and the continuous efforts of various policies to promote consumption, the automobile market has recovered rapidly, and the production and sales of automobiles have increased for many consecutive months, among which the performance of commercial vehicles is particularly outstanding. At the same time, with the rapid penetration of new energy, intelligent and other technologies into the commercial vehicle field, the commercial vehicle market has also ushered in new development opportunities. Improve customer satisfaction with commercial vehicles, attract more consumers, and bring greater benefits to enterprises. The factors affecting customer satisfaction of commercial vehicles include product performance, sales service, after-sales service, and communication activities, and each factor has a different degree of influence on overall satisfaction. Therefore, this paper proposes a research on the identification algorithm of commercial vehicle influencing factors based on partial least squares structural equation, in order to bring higher quality commercial vehicle after-sales service to customers and comprehensively improve the core competitiveness of commercial vehicle sales enterprises.

articleTitle: Application Maturity Research of Intelligent Condition Monitoring Technology for Rail Transit Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Under the background of the requirement of intelligent interconnection of rail transit electrical equipment, this paper organized the intelligent online monitoring technology, and established the application maturity evaluation system of intelligent electrical equipment condition monitoring technology, involving intelligent sensing, big data analytics, cloud computing and the Internet of things. Using analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy evaluation matrix, the monitoring technology of rail transit electrical equipment is analyzed based on the production capacity, application implementation, implementation benefits, technical reliability, technical economy, technical intelligence, technical automation, policy environment and asset operation. Aiming at the weak links, THE development plan and suggestions of rail transit electrical equipment monitoring technology are put forward, which lays the foundation for the establishment of rail transit electrical equipment intelligentization and its development framework in the field of condition monitoring.

articleTitle: Research Based on LLVM Code Obfuscation Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Computer programs are executed continuously in a certain relatively fixed order of instructions. Replacing these instructions with another more complex order or with different instructions with the same meaning without changing the result of the program will change the logic of the original instructions without affecting the result of the operation, which is the core principle of code obfuscation. In the compilation process, before the compiler compiles the code into the target machine code, it will transform the code into a kind of intermediate code, and then generate the target code after Control Flow Flattening and string encryption obfuscation of the intermediate code, which will make the decompilation work more difficult, thus realizing a code obfuscation system, and through some test cases, the effectiveness and feasibility of the system is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on Task Scheduling Optimi-Zation of Data Center Under Double Carbon Target
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: When a data center is running, the efficiency of task scheduling directly affects its operating efficiency. Aiming at the efficiency of scheduling operation, aiming at low-carbon operation, the optimization algorithm and resource allocation technology of task scheduling are studied. The traditional scheduling optimization algorithm is relatively lacking in the training speed and the state and motion capture ability in the face of complex environments. Therefore, a scheduling optimization learning model is proposed, which accelerates the model training through the experience knowledge base, and establishes a deep reinforcement learning model to obtain more effi-cient and accurate scheduling policy information, and design a coding scheme using idle nodes to speed up task scheduling. Simulation experiments show that it effectively reduces the turnaround time and delay parameters of task scheduling, maximizes the amount of parallel tasks, and has better scheduling efficiency and high-load coping capabilities.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis and Prediction for Prostate Cancer based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This data set was from the prostate cancer early warning data of PLA General Hospital. Logistic regression and decision tree were used to screen the influencing factors of prostate cancer (PCa) and to build a prediction model. Logistic regression showed that total prostate-specific antigen (total PSA, tPSA), serum albumin, alkaline phosphatase, low density lipoprotein cholesterol, Apolipoprotein Al and inorganic phosphorus increased, while f/tPSA(the ratio of free PSA to total PSA) decreased, which was risk factors for prostate cancer. The area under ROC curve predicted by models in the modeling group and verification group was 0.741 (0.706, 0.777) and 0.763 (0.705, 0.821), respectively. The decision tree results showed that PCa prediction rate was 75.2% when f/tPSA $\leq$ 0.098. The top four indicators in terms of importance were f/tPSA, free PSA (fPSA), inorganic phosphorus and tPSA, and the area under ROC curve was 0.735 (0.704, 0.767). This study has provided a basis for assisting clinical diagnosis and improving diagnostic screening of PCa.

articleTitle: Design of a Smart Vest System to Protect and Rescue Fallen Elderly People
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: To detect the unexpected accidental fall and save the elderly in life-threatening scenarios, this research designs a fall alarm system based on MPU6050 and FIBOCOM ADP-L610-Arduino(L610) and controlled by STM32F407ZGT6. The MPU6050 sensor embedded in the abdomen of a wearable vest reports fall detection through offline audible and visual alarm with colored light, Liquid Crystal Display (LCD), and buzzer. The design automatically sends out calls and texts through FIBOCOM ADP-L610-Arduino, updating rescue information via smartphone app based on Alibaba Cloud Computing IOT platform. Elastic protection buffer is also provided by electromagnetic ejection upon falling. The test reveals the accuracy level of fall detection is over 98%, average response time of audible and visual alarm 20ms, smartphone app alarm arrives around 300ms, and calls and texts alarm respond within around 2. 2s. Overall the system achieve good results compared with the existing similar fall detection system.

Author Keywords: Fall detection and protection Multi channel alarm for help

articleTitle: State Sensing and Timely Delay Measurement Method for Virtual Power Plant Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Virtual power plant communication network business shows diversity, flow characteristics of sudden, frequent adjustment and different quality requirement of, it is difficult to guarantee such as delay, packet loss rate and network bandwidth network running status and quality of business operation, which run ensuring quality, difficult to measure quality of business, the business reliability decline, network status is not stable, communication time delay is difficult to control. In this paper, the real-time delay measurement method of communication network performance in virtual power plant convergence control scenario is studied. Firstly, the time synchronization method between virtual power plant aggregation control device and server is studied. Secondly, the state perception and distributed probe measurement technology of virtual power plant communication network are studied, and a distributed delay measurement tool is designed. Finally, a distributed delay measurement method based on service flow is proposed. Through the main nodes deployed in the communication network link probe, to link aggregation control communication network in the virtual power plant, the quality and time delay measurement, accurate real-time transmission for scheduling of distributed resources control instruction to provide technical support, to support distributed grid resources to participate in demand response, load frequency control, such as business, avoid trigger new energy fluctuations harm to stable operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Method of Industrial Terminal Edge Computing Based on Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In accordance with the real-time requirements of edge computing applications, a software-defined virtualization technology for network and network functions will be introduced to reconstruct the edge computing network. Based on this, the online allocation of computing and communication resources is considered to maximize the long-term average success rate of real-time task processing. By establishing Markov’s decision-making process model, a Q-Learning-based resource allocation method is proposed. Because Q-learning takes up a lot of memory when space is large, and dimensional disasters occur. A method for allocating network resources based on dqn is therefore still proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Regional Distribution Behavior Characteristics of Logistics Distribution Based on Trajectory Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the increasing number of distribution vehicles, the distribution behavior of vehicles becomes more and more complex. It is of more and more important significance to analyse the characteristics of distribution behavior by using the trajectory data of distribution vehicles of pure electric logistics for the development of low-carbon economy. The research on the distribution behavior characteristics of pure electric distribution vehicles based on trajectory data can truly reflect the status quo of urban logistics distribution, which is helpful to analyse the distribution and function of urban logistics facilities. Using the urban plots obtained from the main road network of the city as the research unit, the trajectory data of the logistics distribution vehicles is used to calculate the distribution distance time series of different travel areas, and the distribution behavior characteristics in the distribution area are summarized from the perspective of the centralized distribution area, the distribution distance, the distribution function and the regional characteristics are summarized from the perspective of the centralized distribution area, the distribution distance, the distribution function and the regional characteristics.

articleTitle: New Energy Vehicle Full Plastic Body Advanced Manufacturing Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: China’s development of new energy vehicles in recent years is relatively large.The fuel vehicle is mainly maintained for the engine system, and the oil and filter is regularly replaced. New energy vehicles are driven by motors. Naturally, conventional maintenance items such as oil, three filters and belts are omitted. It is necessary to maintain battery packs and motors to keep them clean. From the difference between routine maintenance items, it can be seen that the maintenance of new energy vehicles is simpler and easier than fuel vehicles, so the price is naturally economical.At the same time, relevant policies have also been introduced to support and subsidize the development of new energy vehicles, which makes China’s new energy vehicle industry leapfrog development.One of the most important parts of the car is the body.Since the use of composites in the automotive industry, the materials mainly used in the field of automobile manufacturing are plastic steel, and the overall development of the automotive body is formed.The advanced technology industry of new energy vehicles in China has also been analyzed, in order to study the design and production technology of all-plastic vehicles of new energy vehicles in China, to promote the development of China’s new energy vehicle industry, so as to drive China’s economic growth.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Processing Technology of Big Data Based on Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the development of The Times, the Internet has become an essential part of people’s life.In order to meet the needs of the market, it is necessary to continuously optimize and innovate in technology and display various advantages in the era of big data.Traditional methods such as distributed computing or parallel computing are limited by various conditions and cannot meet specific computing requirements.Therefore, in order to solve this problem, people gradually begin to adopt the computer processing technology of big data based on the background of cloud environment, so as to break these limitations and carry out data calculation more quickly and efficiently.Under the background of the era of big data, the choice of vigorously promoting the use of advanced computer information processing technology can continue to ensure the security of different types of data storage and application, so that the application value of data information can be presented in an all-round way.

articleTitle: Research on Partial Discharge Pattern Recognition and Fault Diagnosis of Switchgear Based on Simplified Features in Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This paper has provided a method for partial discharge pattern recognition and fault diagnosis of switchgear based on simplified features in power internet of things (PIOT). An experimental platform was built, and four typical defect models were designed for simulation of partial discharge in switchgear. Then, transient earth voltage (TEV) was measured and twenty-one features were extracted based on phase and time-series. On this basis, the method of maximum variance analysis was applied for selecting features with high correlation to form the simplified feature set for reducing data transmission pressure in PIOT. Finally, the algorithm of k-nearest neighbor (KNN) was adopted to verify the effectiveness of simplified features for partial discharge pattern recognition. Results show that the average accuracy of pattern recognition based on simplified features is over 90%, and this method can be used for practical application which can reduce the pressure of data transmission and improve the operating efficiency of the monitoring system in PIOT.

articleTitle: A Supervision and Early Warning Method for the Construction Period and Progress of Street Lamps in the Internet of Thing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Although the traditional progress management method has formulated a reasonable construction period plan, due to the lack of corresponding means and mechanism, it may not effectively monitor the progress implementation, and cause the project overdue. Therefore, it’s meaningful to establish a early warning mechanism to predict the progress and take corresponding measures. In recent years, the hot key chain project management method achieves the purpose of completing the project on schedule by establishing the project buffer and monitoring the buffer. The representative third-order matrix progress buffer monitoring and management effective method and the optimized fifth-order matrix progress buffer monitoring method consider the buffer zone and project progress at the same time, take the buffer zone consumption into account, and use the progress matrix to evaluate the project progress as a whole. Although it grasps the project progress more directly and quickly, there are blind spots because it is relatively mechanical, and misjudge may occur. In this paper, the buffer monitoring method is further optimized to restrict the progress proportion and buffer use, make the difference between the project progress percentage and the cumulative buffer use percentage, and divide the difference into areas for control, so as to achieve the purpose of controlling the progress and avoid the delay of project progress caused by mechanical judgment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Enterprise Logistics Information Management System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: At present, the rapid development of IOT technology has been applied in many industries and achieved very significant results, which has brought inexhaustible power to the innovation and development of enterprises. However, the current traditional logistics information management mode of enterprises can not meet the requirements of the current logistics development, so it is urgent to innovate, especially to build a new enterprise logistics information management system combined with the IOT technology. Under this background, this paper analyzes the characteristics and requirements of enterprise logistics management, applies IOT technology to enterprise logistics information management system, and analyzes the design and functions of enterprise logistics information management system in detail on the basis of describing the demand analysis of enterprise logistics information management system. It is hoped that this paper can promote the improvement of enterprise logistics information management level.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Installation Location of Wind Speed Sensor Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to quickly and effectively determine the installation position of the wind speed sensor suitable for the average wind speed of the roadway section, so as to improve the wind measurement accuracy of the downhole wind speed sensor. Starting from the type of roadway section, roadway width, height, support form and other factors, a large number of numerical simulations are carried out by using numerical simulation software by controlling variables, and the changes in the position of the average wind speed circle in the roadway under different variables are obtained. Taking this data as a sample, a prediction model for the distance between the average wind speed circle and the roadway roof based on the BP neural network is constructed. MATLAB software is used for network training, and the predicted value is compared with the simulated value. At the same time, the predicted result is applied to the installation process of the actual wind speed sensor, and the monitoring data of the wind speed sensor is compared with the manual wind measurement data. The results show that the structure of the BP neural network is relatively simple, and it can converge at a relatively fast speed. The maximum error between the predicted value of the average wind speed circle and the top plate position and the simulated value is within 4%. The monitoring data is basically consistent with the manual wind measurement data, and the neural network model is feasible to solve the position change of the wind speed sensor from the roof under different conditions.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Medium and High Voltage Electric Intelligent Topology Editing Tool Considering Distributed New Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The resources, assets, measurement, topology, graphics and other data involved in the field of electric distribution and distributed new energy have the characteristics of wide sources, multiple types, large scale and fast updating. However, the current situation of diversified professional solidification models leads to difficulties in electric data integration, and the integrated dynamic modeling technology of electric data resources needs to be broken through. With the access of large-scale distributed new energy to the electric grid, the uncertainty of source load of distributed new energy intensifies the complexity of time and space of electric distribution resources, format and attribute of data resources with time and space, and puts forward higher requirements for the dynamic expansion ability and temporal expression ability of the data model. At present, the planning, construction and operation, operation, distribution and dispatching and other electric grid integration data homology technology routes mainly adopt data table aggregation, primary key field association and other methods to achieve data level integration. With the continuous development of business, the electric topology is changing rapidly, and the electric topology data in the existing system is also changing. In terms of graphical representation, it is urgent to provide topology editing function in the front-end interface and publish the electric topology changes in real time, so that the whole electric topology planning system can understand and master the real-time topology and provide data support for further decision-making.

articleTitle: A Novel Single-Axis Solar Tracker Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Solar panels with fixed angles can hardly consistently achieve maximum power output because the sun’s rays are not always perpendicular to the panel. To address this problem, a single-axis solar tracker based on reinforcement learning (RL) is designed in this paper. The proposed RLbased solar tracker has a simple structure that no additional sensors or positioning devices are required. Therefore, the maintenance of the proposed tracker is easy to perform. Simulations have been conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed solar tracker. The results demonstrate that the mean absolute error (MAE) between the tracking tilt angle and the theoretical value is within a one-eighth degree.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence-Related Technologies for Internet of Things Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, artificial intelligence technology has been pushed to a new height of technical research.lt not only greatly promoted the reform of productive forces, but also effectively drove the development of market economy.Today’s era is the era of artificial intelligence, and the Internet of Things technology undoubtedly plays a crucial role in the integration of artificial intelligence into daily production and life.Through the Internet of things technology, artificial intelligence and communication technology are combined to form a huge intelligent system between things, so as to realize the intelligent management of production and life with the network.This article will explore the application and development prospects under the Internet of Things.Intelligent technology has great value in the production and development of various industries.The application of artificial intelligence technology has effectively promoted the development of the Internet of Things technology. This paper will make a simple analysis of the artificial intelligence related technologies applied in the Internet of Things for discussion by industry insiders.

articleTitle: Research on an Uneven Clustering WSNs’ Routing Protocol with Multi-level Energy Heterogeneous for Ecological Agriculture in Hexi Gobi
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: An uneven clustering WSNs’ routing protocol with multi-level energy heterogeneous based on UCR is presented, which is extensively applied for intelligent water-saving irrigation system of ecological agriculture in Hexi Gobi. After the number of cluster heads is calculated in rectangular units with equal size, the number of optimal units is deduced and the cluster radiuses are computed corresponding to nodes with different energy in different units in order to counterpoise energy dissipated between the nodes and effectively reduce energy holes. Simulation experiments show that the proposed protocol has excellence characteristics of survival time and the number of data successfully sent to the base station compared with the UCR, which further balances energy consumption and prolongs the life cycle in network.
