articleTitle: Construction of Credit Bank System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the continuous development of blockchain technology and the widening of application scenarios, its advantages in the credit banking system are reflected. This paper proposes to construct a block including data layer, network layer, consensus layer, contract layer, and application layer. Chain credit banking system, and discuss the process of key data on-chain processing from a business point of view, thus truly improving the credibility and efficiency of credit bank learning achievement certification and conversion.

articleTitle: TOPSIS Comprehensive Evaluation and Multi-objective Decision-Making based Ordering and Transportation Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The procurement and transportation plan of raw materials in the operation of the production enterprise affects the production efficiency of the enterprise and plays an important role in the development of the enterprise. In this paper, a model is established to analyze and solve related problems, and the specific methods are as follows. First, analyze the existing data to determine the supplier’s supply credit, supply capacity, repurchase rate, and supply stability four indicators, and use the arithmetic average method, geometric average method, and eigenvalue method in the AHP to find out Four indicator weights. Substitute the required average weight into the TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation model, calculate the comprehensive score of supplier importance and sort, and determine the top 50 suppliers in importance. Secondly, for the problem of minimizing the number of suppliers, this paper establishes an objective programming model, taking the minimum difference between the actual production capacity and the upper limit of the production capacity as the objective function, and using MATLAB to solve the required quantity of each type of raw material. Use C language to program the optimal solution algorithm to match the order with a larger order quantity to a forwarder with a lower average loss rate, and form a forwarding plan with the smallest loss. Quantitative analysis of the implementation effect of the proposed scheme to prove the feasibility and optimality of the scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Deployment Scheme of Aggregation Control Gateway for Hybrid Network of Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Acquisition Sensing Infrastructure (ASI) is the main technology of Virtual Power Plant. It can send commands to Smart Meters to establish two-way communication. The meters data is aggregated at the Aggregation Control Gateway (ACG) and then send to the Virtual Power Plant center server. In complex and changeable distribution network environment,a data aggregation deployment scheme based on wired-wireless hybrid network is proposed to reduce the cost of ACG placement. This scheme presents the optimization problem of finding the optimal location of the aggregation nodes and divide the placement nodes into available nodes and potential nodes. This kind of hybrid network facilitates communication between the user and the microgrid in its own interior, reducing the latency of energy services and the overhead of data aggregation. Besides, the improved K-means algorithm is proposed to decrease the algorithm complexity. The data results show that the virtual power plant network infrastructure and ACG deployment model based on wired/wireless hybrid network can reduce the cost and the density of ACG.

articleTitle: Analysis of Intellectual Property Rights of New Energy Vehicles in China Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Behind the fierce market competition, the intellectual property rights of new energy vehicles play a vital role. Intellectual property is the main means for enterprises to protect R&D achievements, and it is also the legal guarantee for protecting market leading position. China’s new energy automobile industrialization can never be completely realized in a short time. We must rely on independent research and development automobile enterprises to be down-to-earth, based on the technological development status of the world’s new energy automobile industry, and avoid fatal mistakes to the future automobile industry caused by intellectual property risks. Based on the big data technology, this paper studies the intellectual property rights of China’s new energy vehicles. The research shows that at present, the statistical results of intellectual property rights classification of hybrid vehicles of domestic enterprises are: Chery Automobile Co., Ltd. ranks first, BYD Co., Ltd. ranks second, and Chongqing Changan Automobile Co., Ltd. ranks third. Based on the big data technology, this paper studies the intellectual property rights of China’s new energy vehicles, and puts forward countermeasures and suggestions from the perspective of intellectual property management of the national science and technology plan, so as to strengthen the independent innovation of China’s new energy vehicles and promote the industrialization development.

articleTitle: Parameter Monitoring and Alarm System for Health
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Under the background of modernization, people ‘ s health problems urgently need attention, so an intelligent parameter monitoring and alarming system for health was designed. The system used STM32$\Gamma$407 as the core MCU control, together with temperature sensor DS18B20 and blood oxygen and heart rate monitoring module MAX30102. It could view the human health status on the LCD screen. The system monitored the human body every 5 seconds, measureing heart rate, body temperature and blood oxygen, and started the alarm function when the parameter thresholds was exceeded. The alarm relied on Fibocom L610 to send a distress signal to the outside world. After 12 sets of data tests of 10 testers, the standard deviation of parameters measured by the system was less than 0.76, the data error rate was less than 0.008, and the error value was controlled within ± 0.5. All alarm tests were successful. Above all, the system could stably and accurately measure physiological parameters and give alarm reminders.

articleTitle: The Study on People’s Live -Streaming Consumption of Fresh Products and Its Influencing Factors - A Data Model Analysis in The Context of COVID-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Against the backdrop of the rapid development of e-commerce and the severe blow to fresh food e-commerce shopping caused by the COVID-19 Pandemic, this paper discusses consumers’ perceptions of fresh food in the e-commerce live streaming mode using data mining in conjunction with a literature review and a questionnaire survey before presenting research findings that analyze influencing factors and product purchase behaviours. The total consumption and frequency of live-streaming consumption(FLSC) are closely examined in consumer behaviours. We investigate product’s cost-performance cognitions(PCC), influencers cognitions(IC), logistics cognitions(LC),discounts cognitions(DC), live-streaming platforms cognitions(LPC), on-line interaction cognitions (OIC), live-streaming disadvantage cognitions(LDC), and impulsive consumption cognitions(ICC) as influencing factors. According to the data model fitting results, merchants can refer to research suggestions and optimize their marketing strategies, improve the problems in the fresh food live streaming marketing strategy, and improve consumer satisfaction, thereby promoting the development of fresh food e-commerce.

articleTitle: Intelligent Greenhouse Information Monitoring System Based on ESP32
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence and intelligent hardware, an intelligent greenhouse information monitoring system based on ESP32 is proposed to solve the problem of intelligent agriculture greenhouse information monitoring. The system integrates technologies such as Internet of Things technology. The IOT Flow APP MQTT subscription can be implemented to publish messages, to achieve a mobile message subscription. The advantages are that the optical function of the spectroscopic prism is used to realize a transparent display, and the upper computer and the lower computer run normally.

articleTitle: Capacity Expansion Problem of Strongly Connected Spanning Subgraph with Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Based on the congestion problem faced by flow transmission equipment in communication networks, in this paper, the capacity expansion problem of strongly connected spanning subgraph with constraints (CEPSCSSC) in directed networks is proposed. Firstly, NP-hardness is analyzed via Hamiltonian cycle problem. Secondly, a strongly connected spanning subgraph G’ is constructed by looking for an inverse spanning arborescence and a spanning arborescence with the same root vertex through using Chu-Liu-Edmonds algorithm, and then G’ is modified until the constraint conditions are satisfied by using the basic transformation of the spanning arborescence and the inverse spanning arborescence. so a heuristic algorithm, using the idea of arc exchange with the minimum weight increment, is designed to solve the CEPSCSSC problem. Finally, it is proved that the heuristic algorithm is correct and its time complexity is O (mnlogn).

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Computer Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Nowadays, our human beings are developing with each passing day in science and humanities, especially in the increasingly fierce competition of modern science and technology with information technology as the core content. If we want to keep pace with The Times, we must master information technology.As a result, large-scale information has emerged. Based on this, this paper studies the computer information processing of big data. First of all, it briefly summarizes the relevant contents of the era of big data, then analyzes the challenges and opportunities of computer information processing technology in the era of big data, then discusses computer information processing technology in the era of big data, and finally looks forward to its future development. I hope it. Discussions in this article can promote people to have an in-depth understanding of this aspect.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation Model Based on Data Envelopment Analysis(DEA)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The company’s data analysis system (D&A) analyzes and transforms the redundant data generated during the logistics and transportation process into usable logistics information, and It plays an extremely important role in the process of overseas - inland logistics. The information it determines about, such as container loading and unloading, storage and etc, can be used effectively to bring about a significant increase in logistics efficiency. Therefore, the company needs to evaluate and optimize the D&A system, this paper analyzed the roles of three key components: people, technology, and process, in the D&A system, combined with requirements and many evaluation design principles, and defined 10 evaluation indicators to measure the maturity level of the current D&A system, including 8 input indicators and 2 output indicators, and identified three key performance indicators. Based on the 10 evaluation indicators, an input-oriented BCC model is established, and the system maturity is analyzed by solving the BCC model. Based on the evaluation result data output from our performance model, we perform validity analysis, and give invalid DMU improvement suggestions according to data such as input redundancy and output deficiency. The ultimate goal expected to be achieved is the rational allocation of resources to maximize the potential of data assets and maximize system benefits.

articleTitle: Construction of Logistics Management System of Internet of Things Based on Genetic Algorithm Driven by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: At present, the logistics industry is still in the development stage, and there are some problems such as low transportation efficiency and serious loss, which have a certain impact on the growth of the logistics industry. Supply chain includes supply, manufacturing and distribution. It is a network system of enterprise entities involved in logistics, capital flow and information flow. All resources within the supply chain can be shared under certain conditions. Under the background of the continuous growth of information technology, the logistics industry is constantly optimizing and developing, which reduces the occurrence of information data loss. The logistics industry applying big data can effectively improve the stability and security of the whole physical information in practice, and can effectively avoid the loss of all kinds of information data. Traditional logistics refers to the whole process of delivering goods from the place of supply to different customers in time and safely, relying on manual experience. In this paper, the optimization model of logistics management based on genetic algorithm (GA) is constructed, which provides support for the construction of logistics management system of Internet of Things (IoT) driven by big data, and puts forward the construction strategy of intelligent logistics development mode of IoT and big data.

articleTitle: Technological Evolution of Lithium Batteries for New Energy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In recent years, with the emergence of a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation, the new energy vehicle industry has entered a stage of accelerated development. After years of continuous efforts, China’s new energy vehicle industry has significantly improved its technical level, the industrial system has been gradually improved, and the competitiveness of enterprises has been greatly enhanced, presenting a good situation of “double improvement” in market scale and development quality. Especially with the global goal of “double carbon”, the development of new energy has received more attention because it helps to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, meet the challenges of climate change, and improve the global ecological environment. At the same time, through the cultivation of the whole industrial chain of new energy vehicles by the country over the years, all links have gradually matured, rich and diversified new energy vehicle products continue to meet market demand, the use environment is also gradually optimized and improved, and new energy vehicles have been more and more recognized by consumers.As the top-level architecture design of a new energy development strategy, the state has issued new policies for encouraging investment in the development of new energy electric vehicles, including related policy supporting documents, development strategy planning, new energy electric vehicle industry subsidies and so on.Moreover, these policies have initially entered a new stage of practical operation, which is undoubtedly a powerful booster for the sustainable and vigorous development of new energy electric vehicle related undertakings in China.The development of new energy vehicles is due to the support of national policies, but the greater reason lies in people’s awareness of environmental protection, so the emergence of new energy vehicles is the inevitable development of the automobile industry.

articleTitle: Study on the Control of the Fixation Device for the Dehulling of Thick Shell
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The processing process of thick shell mussel mainly involves classification, cleaning, processing and peeling, sorting and packaging, which is low in efficiency and high in labor intensity. In order to improve the processing efficiency of thickshelled mussel, an economical and environmentally friendly fixation device for thick-shelled mussel was proposed based on the difficulties in the processing and dehulling of thick-shelled mussel. According to the thick shell mussel off half shell fixed device working principle arrangement control flow chart, combined with the specific control requirements for THE SELECTION of PLC, draw the main circuit control diagram, I/O distribution table and program ladder diagram, parallel PLC completed pipeline PLC control ladder diagram program design, and online simulation test on the software. The results show that the structure design can theoretically meet the requirements of automatic half-shell removal of thick shell mussels, and the design of the control system conforms to the action sequence control of the pipeline, and the port runs normally without any error. The signal transmitted by the control system was transmitted to each link to ensure the automatic processing of the whole device. The design of the control system laid a foundation for the practical production and application of thick shell mussel.

articleTitle: The Data Analysis Study on the Purchasing Behavior of Fresh Agricultural Products Under COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to discuss the purchasing behavior (PB), influencing factors, and personal factors of Chinese consumers through literature review, questionnaire survey, and research results. The frequency and amount of purchasing behavior (FPB and APB) are studied in the consumption behavior. In the influencing factors, channel cognitions (CC), product cognitions (PC), and the influence of personal factors on consumer consumption behavior of fresh agricultural products. The FPB and APB are significantly and positively correlated with the CC, PC, and advantage cognition (AC). The FPB and APB are significantly and negatively correlated with disadvantage cognitions (DC). People’s CC, PC, and DC significantly affect their FPB and APB.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Internet of Things Monitoring System Based on Neural Network Algorithm and Cloud Edge Collaborative Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has the ability to connect things with sensing capabilities all over the world, and it mainly relies on internal base stations to process a large amount of data. In this paper, using server node resources in edge cloud environment, we study and compare the impact of loose coupling and scheduler support on the performance of IoT applications, and introduce three customized offload strategies to meet the different requirements of computingintensive and delay-sensitive IoT applications. Experiments show that computing resources have a greater impact on the performance of IoT applications than communication resources, but when the system is expanded to accommodate more IoT devices, communication bandwidth becomes the dominant resource and directly affects the overall performance of IoT applications. The research on the application of neural network algorithm based on cloud computing in the Internet of Things, firstly summarizes the Internet of Things and neural network algorithm, and then explores the specific application of cloud computing neural network algorithm in the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of the Fourth Party Logistics Platform of Erlianhot Cross-Border E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: At present, the third-party logistics service projects of domestic cross-border e-commerce are difficult to effectively meet the requirements of the rapidly developing cross-border e-commerce logistics.Based on the background of “China-Russia-Mongolia Economic Corridor”, this paper analyses the current situation and existing problems of Erlianhot crossborder e-commerce logistics.On this basis, the fourth party logistics platform of Erlianhot cross-border e-commerce is proposed.

articleTitle: Ethical Implications of AI in Healthcare Data: A Case Study Using Healthcare Data Breaches from the US Department of Health and Human Services Breach Portal between 2009-2021
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Digital technology in the healthcare industry through Artificial intelligence (AI) tools has laid a solid foundation for more convenient and accessible patient treatment, thereby making lives much more manageable. Recent developments in A I tools in the healthcare industry have heightened the need for healthcare professionals to identify and address ethical issues in digital health care. Notwithstanding the benefits of AI tools, healthcare industry data has become a central target for many cyber invaders in this era of big data, as they are regarded as valuable information. Health care data breaches occur due to unauthorized access to patients’ health records that violate the privacy and security of confidential health information. Therefore, this study aimed to use Microsoft Power BI tools to conduct in-depth data analytics and visualization on healthcare data breaches to determine the causes of the breach and provide insights that will help to enhance healthcare data security and confidentiality. This study observed from the analysis that Hacking /IT incidents are the major predominant types of data breaches in the healthcare industry, followed by unauthorized access/disclosures. This study was able to identify the significant factors that contribute to healthcare data breaches. The insight produced from this study could potentially contribute to our understanding of data breaches and set the benchmark that future security experts will undoubtedly tackle. Therefore, more in-depth studies are highly needed to validate the findings as this study has several important implications for future discovery. All the results are subject to the validity of the dataset analyzed.

IEEE Keywords: US Department of Health and Human Services

articleTitle: Towards a Working Conceptual Framework: Cyber Law for Data Privacy and Information Security Management for the Industrial Internet of Things Application Domain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: For Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) and Big Data - Data Privacy presents significant challenges in Cyber Security - specifically in the technological and legal environment. The pervasiveness of computers with the advancement of network infrastructures, systems, and applications makes gathering, interpreting, and propagating personal information more streamlined. Therefore, in the UK, strict adherence to the law is inevitable. The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is one of the EU’s most comprehensive legislative proposals. It is being developed to centralize the data protection law across the EU and help users and data subjects control their data better. Businesses are facing heavy penalties in the form of fines for non-compliance to this recent act - facing heights of 20 million euros (or 4% of their global turnover). This paper focuses on the key challenges and solutions to Data Privacy in the modern world with an enhanced focus on IIoT as an ideal application domain due to its rising innovations in the contemporary world. We propose a Methodology for analyzing Data Privacy incidents to optimize organizational GDPR compliance and aid through operational organization adoption to cybersecurity professionals and decision-makers. Furthermore, to make proficient updates and upgrades to their methods of handling data and ensure Data Privacy for their respective stakeholders aiming to protect and defend the business from financial loss, reputational damage, and stakeholder damage.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Ethics and Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Intelligent Data Analytics is a valuable technique for analyzing the more profound values covered within the endless streams of information created in our lives nowadays. It has been applied to a variety of domains, such as healthcare, social media, manufacturing industries, etc. In particular, it significantly improves manufacturing systems by conducting scheduling, monitoring, quality evaluation, and failure detection, which are the most typical industrial activities. While Intelligent Data Analytics brings numerous benefits to the manufacturing industry and helps address its challenges, several new ethical issues also arise. This paper identifies the challenges faced by the manufacturing sector and introduces how the applications of Intelligent Big Data Analytics address these issues. In addition, it identifies the benefits it brings and the ethical issues it faces.

articleTitle: Externalization and Ownership of Cybersecurity for (Smart) Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Building Automation Systems and Smart Buildings are increasingly more common due to energy efficiency or occupant comfort requirements. Whereas Buildings were early adopters of networked automation, we see that cybersecurity, across its components, has been lagging, which is made more challenging with the fast convergence with conventional IT technologies such as the Cloud. The central problem seems to be that the rich set of products and services offered in the IT market are not mirrored for Buildings. This paper revisits cybersecurity for Buildings from the perspective of stakeholders so to identify the ownership processes. After holding interviews, we identify the key stakeholders involved in Building Management and lay out the key relationships. From there, we use Responsible-Accountable-Consulted-Informed (RACI) matrices to map out ownership and roles for Cybersecurity. Our key conclusion is that we find ownership unclear, a problem that may be hindering the maturity of the sector.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation for IoT-Based Monitoring System Based on Cloud Models and Probabilistic Linguistic Terms Sets
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The Internet of things (IoT) technology is becoming more and more sophisticated in all aspects of life and the involvement of IoT will be seen in all aspects of the development of the internet of things system has brought great convenience and different technical specifications for automation monitoring. As the number of devices connected to the IoT system is increasing, its expansion has become a major design goal in its automated IoT monitoring system. It can greatly solve the shortcomings of the traditional monitoring software to achieve all-round monitoring, so that people can enjoy a comfortable network environment for life and work. The reliability problem of IoT monitoring system appears along with it, so this paper focuses on the reliability evaluation for IoT monitoring system, and the cloud model assessment method is used to assess the IoT monitoring system. And the factors within the IoT monitoring system that are most influential to the reliability are identified by the probabilistic linguistic terms sets.

articleTitle: Graph Alignment Transformer for More Grounded Image Captioning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) generates massive amounts of data that are the cornerstone for companies to increase productivity and provide reliable services. Based on these data, predictive and in-depth analysis can be used to identify weaknesses and make improvements. And how to analyze these data efficiently, effectively and safely requires us to explore. We expect to exploit these data by using methods of deep learning, and image captioning is one of the meaningful tasks. Image captioning aims to describe a given image in natural language. It is well believed that mining relationships between objects is a proven method to improve the performance of reasoning. These methods often extract the general relational expressions on another visual relationship benchmark. And it usually brings redundant connections between region pairs. In this paper, we propose a novel Graph Alignment Transformer (GAT) that models visual relationships in an unsupervised way to perform multimodal representation. Without taking the pre-training approach to obtain the explicit relational expressions, our model still achieves comparable results. Furthermore, we design a Graph Alignment (GA) module to explore semantic and visual alignment at node-level and graph-level, lead to accurate captions. We measured our method on the benchmark MSCOCO image captioning dataset and conduct ablation studies to investigate its effectiveness both quantitatively and qualitatively. Compared to state-of-the-art manners, our propose approach yields an impressive result.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Terminal Sales Application Product Force Marketing Based on Big Data Analysis Under the Background of New Car Retailing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In recent years, China’s economy has developed rapidly, and China’s automobile industry has also developed rapidly, not only with a very fast growth rate, but also with an increasing absolute amount every year. Based on this background, the new retail concept came into being. In the new retail model, “people, goods and markets” were disrupted and reorganized, and the time and place would no longer be restricted, as would the quantity and type of goods. Traditional channel marketing would change greatly, and omni-channel marketing would become the mainstream. The marketing channel optimization strategy of auto financing company’s retail products is proposed from five aspects: defining the target and structure of marketing channels, consolidating the brand influence in the channels, strengthening the development of channel publicity activities, improving the management mechanism for dealers, and taking multiple measures to strengthen the maintenance of existing channels. This paper summarizes the main sales models of the automobile sales industry, and analyzes the internal and external environment of the automobile sales industry using the five forces model. Furthermore, the paper collects data through questionnaires, and conducts research on automobile marketing by using principal component analysis and SICAS model, which provides a theoretical basis for the automobile sales model under the new retail.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Method Based on FSA-Choquet Fuzzy Integral
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the instant development and wide application of sensor technology, human behavior recognition based on wearable sensors has attracted wide attention and become a hot research topic. The typical Choquet fuzzy integral feature selection method considers the interaction between classes, but the preferred features are not tested in the feature selection process. The selected feature subset is not suitable for different classifiers and different classification actions, and there are redundant features. Consequently, this paper proposes an adaptive feature selection method named Feature Selection based on the Adaptive Choquet fuzzy integral (FSA-Choquet). This proposed method can get the optimal subset by two times of feature selections. First, Choquet fuzzy integral is applied to optimize the current optimal feature subset. Then the feature selection is processed by combining the maximum redundancy calculation with the backward floating search strategy and classifier. At last, Experiments show that the feature based on FSA-Choquet selection has a higher classification recognition rate in behavior recognition. Under the comparison based on SVM classifier, the recognition accuracy of the features selected by FSA-Choquet is as high as 89.6 %, and the recognition rate of the features selected by Choquet is 77.36 %. Besides, Under the classifier based on Naive Bayes (NB), the classification recognition rate of FSA-Choquet is 91.67 %, while that of Choquet is only 82.3 %.

articleTitle: Reducing Workload of Manual Annotation for User Requests via a Novel Active Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Classifying user requests is the first step of transforming them into structured requirements specifications. Manual classification is time-consuming, labor-intensive and error prone. Many supervised learning methods therefore have been proposed for automatic classification. These methods need to manually annotate large amount of data instances to train a model to automatically classify the others. To reduce workload of manual annotation, Active Learning (AL) have been proposed. Few works have been done to employ AL in user requests classification. However, these works could not avoid missed class effect and sampling bias, which are two common problems in AL and would be severer in user requests classification. In this paper, we propose a novel active learning framework, including seed selection strategy and query strategy, to solve above two problems respectively. Seed selection strategy extends Gaussian Mixture Model through text similarity and query strategy combines uncertainty sampling with diversity measured by domain knowledge of user requests. An empirical evaluation on there datasets containing user requests from different open source projects demonstrates that our method could reduce more workload of manual annotation than baseline approaches while performance of the model does not decrease.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Deep Learning in Stomatology Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the development of computer science and technology, artificial intelligence is becoming mature in every field of life, and the medical The combination of deep convolutional neural networks with various fields in the medical industry is also an emerging The combination of deep convolutional neural networks with various fields in the medical industry is also an emerging direction of medical research, which has made impressive achievements in diagnosis and prediction in medical imaging and pathology. The medical industry is stepping into the era of artificial intelligence. deep learning developed from artificial intelligence is changing the traditional Deep learning developed from artificial intelligence is changing the traditional medical diagnosis and treatment model and is bound to be an important development trend of future medicine. This paper reviews the development history of deep learning and the research development of deep learning in assisted diagnosis of stomatology.

articleTitle: Exploration of Cultural Tourism Transformation and Upgrading from Rural Revitalization Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the post-epidemic era, comprehensive industrial transformation and upgrading is strong support to promote cultural tourism high-quality development, to cultivate new business forms, and an important force to boost rural revitalization. From the Wuli—Shili-Renli (WSR) methodology perspective, this paper constructs the three-dimensional inner logic framework of cultural tourism transformation and upgrading, and further puts forward the behavioral logic framework with seven main steps. Then a practical path for the cultural tourism transformation and upgrading with “three integrations” is also construed. Finally, it summarizes relevant reflection to cultural tourism transformation and upgrade. Combine with the WSR system method, this paper can not only enrich the logic mode analysis of industrial transformation and upgrading, but also provide certain methods and practical reference from a systems way of thinking. It also enriches the WSR systematic research to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-dimensional Evaluation Method and Model of Automobile Patent Value
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the progress of science and technology and the transformation of China’s economic development mode, the basic guarantee function of intellectual property system to stimulate innovation is more prominent. As the precondition of intellectual property operation, the evaluation of intellectual property value is the precondition of commercial application of intellectual property. Under this premise, how to objectively evaluate the value of new energy vehicles and develop the evaluation of new energy vehicles in the direction of scale and standardization has become a problem worthy of attention. As an important part of manufacturing industry, automobile enterprises must be at the forefront of technological innovation if they want to achieve sustainable development. By comparing the impact of the primary market and the secondary market on the price of electric vehicles, the market differences of characteristic variables are studied. Through further conversion and analysis of the model, it is verified whether the endowment effect has a regulatory effect on the price of electric vehicles. And building the evaluation system of technological innovation has become an important magic weapon for automobile enterprises to understand their own innovation status and industry innovation dynamics. The operation theory and evaluation method constructed in this paper will help enrich the research in the field of vertical industry incubators, provide clear case study results for the industry, and thus improve the level of innovation incubation and value evaluation management decision-making in the automotive industry.
